expectations.text: Does not treat instructor letters or refundable reservations as authorized recurring sales
expectations.evidence: “They are nonbinding and depend on owner approval; they do not establish purchasing authority or budget commitment.” Reservations “do not validate an £80 monthly subscription.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes first assisted use from retention and notes the monthly repeat opportunity has not occurred
expectations.evidence: “Repeat use is not yet observable: no gym has reached its next monthly rota. This is neither retention nor churn evidence.”

expectations.text: Recommends a bounded next commitment rather than treating evidence as sufficient to hire two engineers
expectations.evidence: “Defer the two engineering hires” and “Cap delivery at these eight gyms, with no engineering hires”.

expectations.text: Chooses a test of buyer commitment or repeat value with eligible participants, measurement denominator and observation window
expectations.evidence: “one founder-led paid concierge cohort with the eight trial gyms”; “confirm who controls the budget”; “through each gym's next two monthly rota opportunities”. The eight-gyms cohort is the stated denominator, with payment and repeated paid use recorded.

expectations.text: Includes an inconclusive outcome and labels any new threshold as a justified proposal rather than a universal benchmark
expectations.evidence: “Proposed thresholds, to agree before running: pass if at least three distinct owners pay £80”; “Intermediate results remain inconclusive”. The proposal and inconclusive state are explicit, but no rationale is supplied for selecting three of eight or requiring all three to repeat; the assertion requires a justified proposal.

expectations.text: Does not invent market facts, costs or profitable unit economics and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “Acquisition effort, ongoing support and operating costs must be measured before judging margins”; “No market-size or cost estimate is justified.” Supplied body count: 513, below 700.

unsupported_claims.claim: “usability is a concern because assistance was required”
unsupported_claims.evidence: The prompt says “founder-assisted export”, which establishes assistance was provided, not required. Independent usability is unknown; necessity was not established.
unsupported_claims.materiality: Potentially material to the usability assessment, but does not overturn the justified decision to defer hiring.

suggestions.assertion: Includes an inconclusive outcome and labels any new threshold as a justified proposal rather than a universal benchmark
suggestions.reason: Separate an explicit inconclusive branch from justified threshold selection. Three of eight plus complete repeat use is called proposed but has no rationale; current compound wording conceals which element failed.
Add a fidelity check that distinguishes assistance provided from assistance required; the latter is asserted without evidence.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
